answer: Autonomous agents achieve Sybil resistance by anchoring recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments into verifiable delay primitives that impose a physical time-throttle on identity generation. This bottleneck prevents adversaries from deploying a mirror image of their compute to synthesize concurrent proofs, bounding the forgery horizon via strictly enforced sequentiality. By structuring staking collateral across a tiered terrace, slashing penalties derived from succinct protocol audits ensure negative expected attack utility and robust Nash equilibrium.
